about_the_game:
The Age of Navigation game has a brand new sailing world to experience, all dynamic events can be challenged, find different camps to confront, build a wonderful sailing world to experience different experience points, experience in the novel chapters of adventure, all stories can be played, challenge in the interesting and adventurous tasks, and compete for different materials and supplies.

Features of the Age of Navigation game:

1. Adventure on a fully free map, enhancing different interesting battles;

2. A new 360-degree transformation, in different naval battle scenes, realistic and enjoyable experience of thrilling naval battles;

3. All thrilling and tortuous tasks, find lost ships, rescue merchant ships at any time, and capture evil pirate leaders.

Gameplay of Age of Navigation:

1. A huge game territory can be fought for, and all the gameplay can be experienced to your heart's content. Fight freely here;

2. Players can unite different trade caravans, all combat effectiveness can be improved, and fight hard with bosses;

3. Compete in different game copies, strengthen yourself through different trade wars, and quickly explore the terrain.

  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1024x768 pixel over
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Window 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2500 or AMD FX 6350
